objective: Confirm each stakeholder need is understandable, sourced, consistent with the context, and represented by system requirements.
expected_evidence: Review record and need-to-system trace report

objective: Demonstrate data and power interoperability with representative conforming logger interfaces, including the mount-duration bound.
expected_evidence: Protocol, interface configurations, captured transfers, power measurements, and mount timing

objective: Measure synchronization error and verify logger-relative to UTC association and configured local-time presentation.
expected_evidence: Clock-reference record, observed timestamps, and error calculations

objective: Exercise each local state and control and observe the display, mute behavior, and disabled-monitoring indication.
expected_evidence: Procedure, device configuration, photographs or captured display states, and observations

objective: Inject alarm conditions and measure local annunciation, remote submission latency, content, and gateway outcome reporting.
expected_evidence: Injected event log, synchronized timestamps, sound measurement, notification capture, and results

objective: Operate the device without supplied power at 43 degrees Celsius for 240 hours while exercising allocated essential functions and power limits.
expected_evidence: Chamber and device configuration, calibrated measurements, event record, and endurance observations

objective: Interrupt and restore communications and verify retention, automatic reconnect, idempotent replay, and explicit interval status.
expected_evidence: Network-fault schedule, device and service logs, record comparison, and status captures

objective: Compare acquired, transmitted, stored, and exported objects with the declared WHO data format and verify logger files remain unmodified.
expected_evidence: Schema or field comparison and file-digest comparison

objective: Inspect storage lifecycle rules and capacity evidence against the three-year retention obligation for every record class.
expected_evidence: Lifecycle configuration, capacity analysis, and record-class inventory

objective: Attempt permitted and prohibited data and administrative operations using representative employer and role assignments.
expected_evidence: Authorization matrix, test identities, requests, and observed decisions

objective: Request boundary-spanning exports and compare package content, documentation, and digest with the retained source records.
expected_evidence: Export request, package, source comparison, and independent digest result

objective: Change each controlled configuration class and verify actor, time, previous value, and new value are recorded before application.
expected_evidence: Change requests and resulting immutable audit records

objective: Inspect every excursion presentation and export for the required disposition boundary and absence of automated disposition classifications.
Inject interface, power, device, and communication faults and verify code distinction, persistence, and field-service access.
expected_evidence: Fault-injection procedure, observed codes, retention record, and service demonstration

objective: Alter and truncate transferred and exported artifacts and verify detection, rejection from operational use, and status reporting.
expected_evidence: Original and modified artifacts, digests, service outcomes, and interface captures

objective: Inspect enclosure qualification evidence against the required IP64 classification.
expected_evidence: Supplier or laboratory classification report tied to the tested enclosure configuration

objective: Review system requirements against allocated lower-level requirements and verification coverage for omitted behavior or conflicting bounds.
